shipment_events.description: 443.385 MT of aluminum ingot fully received into storage; the Nanhai, Foshan designated warehouse issued electronic warehouse receipt EWR-2026-FS-AL0-00015.
Buyer and seller completed spot cash settlement; ownership of the warehouse receipt transferred from Shanghai Jinyuan to SouthMet Foshan.
SouthMet Foshan confirmed pickup / title transfer; spot delivery is complete.

macro_risk_events.description: Social inventories of aluminum ingot in Foshan stand at about 180,000 MT, a moderately low level for the year. Primary aluminum smelters in Yunnan are restarting slowly during the wet season, and the South China spot premium remains at 50-80 CNY/MT.
The primary aluminum capacity ceiling policy (45 million MT) remains in place. The pace of restarts after power rationing in Yunnan is uncertain, and tight supply is supporting aluminum prices.
